title: Higher-quality gptimage for Nectar
summary:
Nectar gets a higher-quality gptimage option, four community projects join the directory, and two small fixes make the docs and model registry less surprising.

Nectar users can request `quality=high` with gptimage. The change also raises their queue concurrency cap from 1 to 3 and shortens the forced interval from 150 to 60 seconds; other tiers retain medium quality and the existing limits.

The project directory now includes an image-generation app, a PR-summarizing GitHub Action, a Python SDK, and a quiz generator. Contributor instructions for submitting projects were also updated.

The API docs now use `gemini-search` in the Search the Web example instead of relying on a default model that lacks web search capability.

highlights.title: Higher-quality gptimage requests
highlights.text: Nectar users can request `quality=high` with gptimage. Other tiers continue to receive medium quality. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage).
